verdict.rationale: Wrike documents native two-way syncs with 22 integrated systems, explicitly naming GitHub (and Jira). It also says it can connect to your apps through its integration platform. Slack and Google Drive are never named, so only part of the story is evidenced, and only by vendor pricing-page claims. Missing for 10: evidence of native Slack and Google Drive integrations, integration setup docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can connect common tools like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive natively

citations.quote: Set up two-way syncs between your Wrike account and 22 integrated systems, including Jira, GitHub, and more.
Connect Wrike to your apps, build no-code automations, and run end-to-end workflows from one secure platform.
